About this digest
  • Next update: Sat Nov 14 (every 5 days, delivered as soon as compiled that morning).
  • Window: Mon Nov 9, 2026 through Sun Nov 15, 2026 — 7 days, America/Los_Angeles. Swept Mon Nov 9, 2026 (PT), with a live-browser verification pass the same day.
  • Home base: ZIP 94560 (Newark, CA). Distances: est. driving miles from 94560, taken from this run's sweep parts; '?' where no prior figure exists.
  • Coverage: baby/toddler/preschool storytimes (ages 0–6) plus all-ages kids/family events AND school-age and teen events — ages 7+ with no ceiling (user-decided 2026-11-02). 965 library events in the day lists below (Mon 11/09: 125 · Tue 11/10: 219 · Wed 11/11: 28 · Thu 11/12: 219 · Fri 11/13: 107 · Sat 11/14: 191 · Sun 11/15: 76) plus 181 Beyond listings; 1146 total listings. Adult-only, virtual/online, and canceled events excluded; 1 virtual item dropped (Livermore Online Author Talk with R.L. Stine, Wed Nov 11 — prior digests carry no virtual events).
  • Verification: V = confirmed live this run (feed or browser pass) — library totals: 965 V, 0 U. Beyond: 181 listings (174 V, 7 U). Feed systems reconciled per day (feed total − excluded = kept) for every feed system; the live-browser pass pinned 151 library events across 10 sources (Berkeley 28, Santa Cruz 33, South San Francisco 11, San Leandro 8, Daly City 6, San Bruno 10, Santa Clara City 15, Livermore 9, Menlo Park 10, Redwood City 21). San Bruno's browser list supersedes the feed list for San Bruno. Tap the V or U to open the event's page.
  • Flags: "free ticket" = pick up at the Children's desk before the program (Hayward rule — see Closures: free ticket 30 min before, every adult AND child, no advance reservations). "borderline" = skews school-age but includes an under-7 age group. "time not shown on listing" = the source page showed no reliable start time (never invented). All-day events are in Activities with "all day" wording so the renderer buckets them separately. Afternoon school-age/teen events carry an amber Afterschool badge.
  • All library events are free unless noted. Non-library sources (bookstores, parks, museums, zoos, nature, art studios, Eventbrite, parent calendars) are mostly PAID — costs shown distinctly (PAID/FREE) in Beyond.
  • Layout: each day is split into Storytimes vs Activities (nearest-first within each). A Nearest | Earliest | Latest toggle re-sorts every list; all-day events go in the All-day bucket. The For you tab picks by age and city; the Digest tab has the full day lists plus an age bar (All / Baby / Toddler / Preschool / Ages 7+ / Free) and one shared search bar.
  • Heads-ups: VETERANS DAY Wed Nov 11 is IN this window: most libraries are closed that day — Berkeley, SCPL, Santa Clara City, Livermore, Redwood City, South San Francisco, San Leandro, Daly City and San Bruno verified closed by the browser pass; SCCLD, SMCL, Palo Alto, CCCL, Mountain View and Los Gatos show closure notices in their feeds; Oakland and SFPL list zero items Wed (a closure signal, not independently confirmed). Only 28 feed events kept Wed (vs 110–184 on other days). Beyond venues are mostly OPEN on Veterans Day — Fairyland special opening + puppet show, CDM extended hours, Crab Cove Remembrance walk, ZooLights, Glowfari, Zoppe specials, three holiday camps. SFPL markup change, repaired this run: sfpl.org dropped the date-display-range span, so the first pass captured no times; times are now parsed from the new ISO attribute — exact start/end, no AM/PM heuristic. Scope alignment: reading-to-dog and homework help are now KEPT in feed systems too (12 reading-to-dog + 34 homework sessions this run), matching the browser pass. Diwali tail: 13 events (Hindi Diwali Storytime @ ACL Mon 11/9, Diwali Treats/Celebration @ Oakland, Moraga Hidden Image Search daily). Moraga storytime is BACK Wed Nov 11; Orinda storytime break continues (until ~Nov 18). SCCLD Woodland Branch is new in the feed (closure notice Wed + two weekend programs). SFPL Mission Branch Grand Reopening Sat Nov 14. Berkeley Comic Con Sat Nov 14 (BPL 4th Annual Comic Con!, 10:30 AM–4:30 PM, plus a Brick by Brick build). Friday is the thin day (86 feed events kept vs 162–184 Tue/Thu/Sat). Children's Fairyland open Fri–Sun plus special Wed 11/11; closed Mon/Tue/Thu. Happy Hollow weekends-only in November. Glowfari + ZooLights running Wed–Sun; San Jose Holiday Lights opens Fri Nov 13; CuriOdyssey IlluminOdyssey opens Sat Nov 14.
